summary: This is an amendment to a Form 8-K (Amendment #1) filed by Groovy Company, Inc. on 2026-05-28. The filing rescinds and withdraws all disclosures previously made in Items 4.01, 5.02, 5.03, and 8.01 of a prior Form 8-K filed on 2026-05-13, pending further review by the Board of Directors. The company states it is reevaluating disclosures regarding changes in certifying accountant, officer/director departures, and corporate governance matters. No specific special-situation transaction or event is described; the filing solely retracts prior statements while an internal review is pending. The current report does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or any other enumerated special-situation category.
